rows.name:
The kid from the fish shop often gives
me food. I hear the kid's mother is
very ill, which must be hard.

rows.label: tlk42100151_04_msg0002
rows.name:
There's something gentle about that
kid's cooking. It reminds me of Gula.

rows.label: tlk42100151_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Give the shop your business if you
can. It would help the kid's mother,
too.
